fix: Add 'index' as a cue for the length/width ratio (Flora Malesiana fern convention: lamina length divided by width): PATO:0001470 ratio, unit ratio, numerator length PATO:0000122, denominator width PATO:0000921, values 2-4.7. Bearer is the lamina of the fertile frond (fertile as bearer state from the 'Fertile fronds:' heading, pattern 12).
reason: 'index' here is the lamina length:width ratio, a standard measure in the Malesian fern treatments; pattern 11 covers it but has no 'index' cue.

fix: Slot 1 (region): add 'basally' as a region cue meaning base (petiole base / basal BSPO region) with PATO:0001571 dilated. The stage reading is wrongly scoped: 'at anthesis' belongs to the clause 'Basal and lower stem leaves mostly present', not to the petiole clause.
reason: A plain region statement; the stage words come from another clause.

fix: Union of two colour values of the bract: brown PATO:0000952 or a 'tinged greenish brown' operand. Missing reading: 'tinged X' as X with value_qualifier approximately (pattern 01), and 'greenish brown' as brown with the greenish modifier already used for colours.
reason: Same-attribute alternative; one operand has no reading for 'tinged'.

fix: Give the FLOPO whole-plant growth-form classes (lianescent/climber, tree, shrub, subshrub) an EQ signature: whole plant PO:0000003 has_characteristic some <growth-form value> (lianescent = climbing, as in rule C354). The RDF record then uses that value as the quality, so 'liana/liane' gets the existing lianescent reading.
reason: 'Lianas' is a valid habit. It is blocked only because the FLOPO class has no EQ definition (signature OTHER).

fix: Stamen with inserted into PATO:0000624 towards corolla tube. The 'or' only joins two positions of the insertion region ('at or above middle'), and pattern 09 keeps that region in comparison_text, so the disjunction check should not block the relation.
reason: Both alternatives give the same relation and target; the disjunction is inside the region phrase.

fix: Ground the container 'limbs' in a petal clause to the petal lamina (PO:0025060 lamina part of petal) by adding 'limb' as a synonym row in the bearer rules. The count is lobe, amount 4. The colour 'violet or pale pink' is a separate pattern 07 union.
reason: 'Limb' is the blade of a clawed petal; the container word is not in the lexicon.

fix: Carry the sentence subject 'Fertile frond' down to its parts. Stipe (PO:0025066 stalk) part of a vascular leaf (frond) with bearer state fertile PATO:0000955; length 2.5-4.6 cm. 'fertile' is a stage word wrongly read here: it qualifies the whole, not a growth stage.
reason: This is the stipe of the fertile frond (the sterile one is given before it); pattern 12 covers this.

target: inner: FLOPO position value for a member of a whorled or imbricate series (phyllaries, tepals, glumes) that is nearer the centre of the series
fix: Bearer phyllary (involucral bract PO:0009045) with bearer_context_quality inner; length 4-5 mm, width ca. 1.5 mm. Pattern 04 already lists inner/outer/upper/lower as proposed values.
reason: Pattern 04 says inner members have no value class yet.
'nombreuses' gives no number. The previous review rejected few/many, and PATO increased amount is relative to a wild type, not to a taxon.

target: medial (sorus position): placed about midway between the costa or vein and the margin
fix: Sorus PO:0025359 has_characteristic medial (a FLOPO position value, sibling of the existing position values). 'dorsal on free veins' is a separate relation statement (pattern 09).
reason: Standard fern position term; PATO has 'lateral to' but no medial between midrib and margin.

fix: Limit the disjunction to its own list item: 'oblong or elliptic' is a shape union (pattern 07), while '8-20 mm long' (length of the leaflet) and '21-33' (leaflet count, container leaf) are separate plain statements.
reason: The length has no alternatives; the annotator applied the 'or' of the shape to the whole comma list.

target: accrescent: enlarging or lengthening after flowering
fix: Pedicel has_characteristic accrescent (FLOPO value under size). The 'up to 14 mm long' that follows is a length with stage 'in fruit' (stage pattern A) plus an upper bound (pattern 02).
reason: 'lengthening in fruit' is the standard character accrescence, not a process to drop.

fix: Entity should be lemma ('flowering scales' of the grass spikelet), not sepal. Then '3-nerved' is a pattern 03 count (vein, amount 3, container lemma).
reason: Pleuraphis is a grass; 'flowering scales' are lemmas. Also, 'nerved' is a counted part, not a missing unit.

fix: Resolve 'each' to the subject 'Locules' and repair the line-break hyphen ('contain- ing'). Seed, amount 0-1, container fruit locule PO:0025270.
reason: A count of seeds per locule; the container is in the same sentence.

fix: Map 'N mm thick' to PATO:0000915 thickness (the attribute, not the value 'thick'), and add 'fully' as a lower-bound cue (>= 1 mm). Bearer is seed.
reason: An ordinary numeric thickness; it fails only on the mapping of 'thick' and the unknown cue 'fully'.

fix: Entity should be the hairs (trichome part of flower), quality length 0.3-0.6 mm; colour rust-coloured (brown/reddish brown) as a second statement of the same hairs.
reason: 'hairs' is the bearer, not a quality; the number measures the hairs, not the flower.

fix: Bearer vascular bundle PO:0005020 (of the leaf blade); quality surrounded by PATO:0005016 towards bundle sheath PO:0006023. 'surrounded by' is in the pattern 09 table, but the transcriber put the target part into the quality slot.
reason: This is the 'surrounded by' relation of pattern 09; the target grounds in PO.

fix: Add a grounding rule: 'd.b.h.'/'dbh' is the diameter PATO:0001334 of the stem (trunk, PO:0009047) at breast height, keeping 'at breast height' in RDF; 'to 60 cm' is the existing upper bound. The bearer is the stem, not the whole plant.
reason: The upper-bound cue 'to' is supported; the abbreviation is not.

fix: A pattern 09 relation plus a measurement of the offset: anther with exserted PATO:0000623, and a distance PATO:0000040 towards the corolla (mouth) with value 2.5-4 mm and unit. OWL: has_part some (anther and has_characteristic some (distance and towards some corolla and magnitude range)). The short-styled flower is the qualified whole (pattern 12).
reason: Pattern 09 says comparisons with a measurement are not read; 'exserted N mm' is common in heterostylous and other descriptions.

target: mat-forming: whole-plant growth form forming a low, dense carpet of spreading, rooting stems
fix: Handle as a growth-form value of the whole plant (same treatment as growth-form-class). 'creeping and rooting at nodes' in the same sentence is already a separate statement.
reason: A recognized habit term (common in FNA); it describes the whole plant, not the stem.

fix: Map 'N mm thick' to PATO:0000915 thickness (same rule as P01254); 'ca.' is the approximation cue. Bearer is seed, value 2 mm.
reason: A plain numeric thickness; only the 'thick' to thickness mapping is missing.

fix: Bearer frond (vascular leaf PO:0009025), quality distance PATO:0000040 towards the same class, value >= 1 cm ('or more' as lower bound, pattern 02). The axis they are spaced along (rhizome) goes in RDF. OWL: has_part some (vascular leaf and has_characteristic some (distance and towards some vascular leaf)).
reason: annotation-context-patterns section 3 sketches spacing ('1-2.5 cm apart') but there is no pattern file and it is not implemented.

fix: Accept an en dash in the 'N–M-xed' split: '5–9-veined' gives vein, amount 5-9, container glume PO:0009039. 'upper' (glume) has no value class yet (pattern 04 limits).
reason: 'veined' is already in flora_counted_parts.tsv; the range with an en dash was misread as a measurement with no unit.

fix: Slot 1 region: 'from the middle' gives the distal region (BSPO) of the stem leaf, with a narrowing (tapered/attenuate) shape value; drop 'of leaves' from the quality.
reason: This is shape along the length of the leaf, not a relation to another part. A region reading fits but needs a 'from the middle' cue.

fix: 'taller than' is a pattern 09 comparison (increased height towards X). Missing: grounding 'the cells beneath' (the lower lamella cells) to a PO cell class other than the bearer, with 'somewhat' as the approximation cue.
reason: The comparison words are covered; the target 'cells beneath' does not ground.

fix: Add 'sect'/'sected' (and 'secta') to config/flora_counted_parts.tsv giving lobe (segment) of the leaf lamina. '3-sect or -parted nearly to base' gives the same count 3 under both words.
reason: FOC writes '3-sect' for three-sected; the suffix is missing from the table.

target: falling (said of an organ): read as the existing PATO:0001730 deciduous (generic); a synonym rule, no new class
fix: Stipule has_characteristic deciduous (generic) PATO:0001730, as for caducous organs in the NCVC normalization.
reason: 'Falling' in the Africa tree DB means caducous; the term exists, the reading does not.

fix: Count of ovule (amount 1-2) with container megasporophyll PO:0009027 and bearer_part the side of the distal part of its stalk (slot 1). OWL: has_part some (megasporophyll and has_part some (ovule and has_characteristic some amount ...)); the position stays in RDF.

target: se détachant (par écailles/plaques): French reading of the existing FLOPO:0991021 exfoliating; a synonym rule, no new class
fix: Bark has_characteristic exfoliating FLOPO:0991021 (synonyms already include peeling, flaking); 'grandes écailles irrégulières' stays in RDF.

fix: Counted part leaf PO:0025034, amount 4-6, container branch PO:0025073 from 'per ultimate branch' (strip 'per'; 'ultimate' gives terminal as the container's state). The transcriber put the container in the entity slot.

This counts the phyllaries that grade into the peduncle bracts: a transition between two organ kinds, not a quality of a defined bearer. Too unclear to annotate.

fix: 'longer than' gives increased length PATO:0000573 towards stem internode PO:0020142. Missing: grounding of the plural 'internodes' (culm internodes), and of the bearer 'culm sheath'.

fix: Entity should be the hairs (trichome part of petiole), quality length with upper bound 0.5 mm ('to', pattern 02).

fix: Same as P01243: whole plant PO:0000003 has_characteristic lianescent (climbing), once the growth-form classes have an EQ signature. Add 'liane' as a wording.

fix: Add 'younger' / 'the younger' as a bearer_quality row giving young (PATO) for branch in config/flora_context_words.tsv. Map 'grass green' to green PATO:0000320.

'nombreux' gives no number; same as P01248 and the earlier rejection of few/many.

fix: The 'Male flowers:' heading makes the sepal part of a flower with male PATO:0000384; yellowish = yellow PATO:0000324 with value_qualifier approximately.

fix: Temporal transition: qualitative_value_relation from scaly PATO:0001804 (when young) to glabrous (with age) on the sporocarp. Add 'with age' as a later-state cue.

fix: Split the hyphenated compound: petiole has_characteristic puberulous FLOPO:0991049, plus the hairs (trichome part of petiole) with an orientation or shape value (incurved, curved PATO:0000406). The same split covers appressed-, retrorse-, spreading-pubescent.

'unknown' records missing knowledge, not absence; it is not a phenotype of the taxon.
